messages:
elaine: Heads-up — we got a customer report that the old /v1/webhook endpoint returns 404s after the shim started returning 410 intermittently. Can docs team coordinate a deprecation note + migration guide?

sam: ack. I can draft deprecation notice. Proposing: announce today as 'deprecation start', soft-redirect for 30 days, full removal 2025-07-15. Thoughts? :calendar: :eyes:

maya: +1 to dates, but we need exact SDK snippet changes and a copy for the changelog. Also: update the 'webhook' migration guide and add a short quickstart for the v2 signed webhook flow.

kevin: What's the compatibility impact for SDKs? I think v2 changes the auth header from `X-Webhook-Token` -> `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and requires the `X-Webhook-Signature` verification. SDKs will need a helper to validate signatures.

sam: right — I'll add an SDK checklist. Plan: docs PR w/ (1) deprecation notice (top-level), (2) migration guide (step-by-step), (3) code snippets for JS/Python, (4) redirect note for existing links. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1849

maya: nice. Can you include a minimal smoketest in the PR that runs the example and checks signature header? We should wire it into docs CI.

kevin: I'll prepare helper functions and tests in the SDK repos. Suggest function name `verifyWebhookSignature(payload, signature, secret)` across libs. Example (JS):

```js
// libs/webhooks.js
const crypto = require('crypto')
function verifyWebhookSignature(body, sig, secret) {
  const h = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(body).digest('hex')
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(h), Buffer.from(sig))
}
module.exports = { verifyWebhookSignature }
```

elaine: great. For docs text: include migration steps like: 1) rotate tokens, 2) add signature verification, 3) update handler to read Bearer token, 4) enable v2 in console. Also add a troubleshooting Q&A.

sam: I'll write the initial draft and ping owners. Breakdown of PR tasks: - deprecation notice (sam) - migration guide prose + examples (maya) - SDK helpers + tests (kevin) - CI smoke test (maya) - release note entry (elaine)

maya: assigning and rough ETA: draft by EOD, tests by Wed. I'll add checkboxes in the PR description.

docs-ci-bot: build #882 passed for PR 1849 — small lint fixes needed (links).

kevin: FYI — one subtlety: some customers use webhook URLs embedded in third-party services. We should include a short section on regenerating and updating URLs, plus curl examples for token rotation.

sam: good call. Add example curl for rotating token and sample response. Also add inbound link redirects in the docs site config (we need to map `/v1/webhook` to the migration page for 30 days).

maya: adding a 'how to test locally' snippet:

```bash
# simulate signed webhook
PAYLOAD='{"event":"message.created"}'
SECRET=localtestsecret
SIG=$(echo -n $PAYLOAD | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac $SECRET | sed 's/^.* //' )
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/webhook -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token" -H "X-Webhook-Signature: $SIG" -d "$PAYLOAD"
```

elaine: please include a short troubleshooting checklist: 401s -> check Bearer token; 400s -> signature mismatch; 410s -> use new endpoint or temporary redirect header.

sam: I'm going to post the deprecation note draft to #announcements after we merge docs PR. Can we target merge by EOD tomorrow?

kevin: SDK PRs will be ready for review by noon tomorrow.

maya: merging main docs changes now into branch `webhook/shim-removal`. PR updated with TODO checklist and examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1849/files

docs-ci-bot: preview site built: https://deploy-preview-1849--docs.redwood.ai/webhook-migration

elaine: quick question — should we add a small sample app under `examples/webhooks/` to show end-to-end? I think yes.

sam: yes please — that will help customers. Maya, can you add an example app and link it from the guide?

maya: yes. I'll add a tiny Node/Flask example and a README with steps.

kevin: once merged, please notify platform-support for a console flag to enable the 30-day redirect for existing customers.

elaine: noted. I'll file an internal ticket and tag platform-support.

sam: final checklist before merge: responsive code snippets (JS + Python), signature verification helpers, smoke tests green, redirect mapping added, release note prepared. If all green, I merge and we announce. :rocket:

maya: ack, moving to final review.

kevin: thanks team — will add SDK release notes linking to the migration guide.

elaine: thanks all. I'll prepare the announcement copy once PR is merged.
